description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the 'JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino' class, focusing on sandboxing capabilities and handling of potentially malicious or resource-intensive scripts. It verifies that the mapper correctly prohibits dangerous JavaScript operations like exit, quit, endless loops, recursion, and excessively large scripts.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhinoSandboxingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that enforces sandboxing rules of the JavaScript message mapper, ensuring execution safety by testing restrictions on CPU, recursion, and script size.

methods.name: ensureExitForbidden
methods.description: Tests that an exit() call within the script triggers a MessageMappingFailedException.

methods.name: ensureQuitForbidden
methods.description: Tests that a quit() call within the script triggers a MessageMappingFailedException.

methods.name: ensureEndlessLoopGetsAborted
methods.description: Verifies that a script with an infinite loop is aborted and throws an exception.

methods.name: ensureRecursionGetsAborted
methods.description: Ensures that recursive function calls in scripts are properly aborted and result in an exception.

methods.name: ensureTooBigMappingScriptIsNotLoaded
methods.description: Checks that scripts exceeding the maximum allowed size are rejected.

methods.name: createMapper
methods.description: Helper method that creates and configures a JavaScriptMessageMapper instance with a specified malicious script segment.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a sample ExternalMessage with headers and payload for testing.

methods.name: getMappingWrapperScript
methods.description: Constructs a JavaScript snippet that incorporates malicious code for testing sandbox restrictions.
